segments.name: Sports & Leisure
segments.description: Digital media brands covering sports and enthusiast leisure interests for fans and outdoor audiences.
segments.evidence: Sports & Leisure Vertical - our Sports & Leisure vertical is anchored by iconic legacy brands and high-velocity digital properties that capture the full spectrum of fan and enthusiast interests.

segments.name: Finance
segments.description: Business news, market data, analysis and investigative journalism serving high-intent finance and automotive audiences.
segments.evidence: Finance Vertical – our Finance vertical delivers high-intent audience segments through its business news coverage, market data and analysis, and investigative journalism.

segments.name: Lifestyle
segments.description: Entertainment and lifestyle content brands driving daily engagement across broad consumer interests.
segments.evidence: Lifestyle Vertical – our Lifestyle vertical leverages widespread brand recognition to drive daily engagement across a broad range of consumer interests through entertainment and lifestyle content.

segments.name: Platform & Other
segments.description: Proprietary publishing and monetization platform serving independent Publisher Partner websites.
segments.evidence: Platform & Other Vertical - in addition to the owned-and-operated brands included in the verticals above, we empower an ecosystem of Publisher Partners.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from advertisers, affiliate and performance marketing partners, digital subscribers, and Publisher Partners who pay to use its publishing and monetization platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Platform offers audiences bespoke content with optimized design and page construction.

changes.text: In 2025, Men's Journal was reclassified from Lifestyle into the Sports & Leisure vertical, with prior periods recast.
changes.evidence: The brand Men's Journal is organized under the subject matter vertical of Sports & Leisure for the year ending December 31, 2025.

changes.text: In early 2024, the company ceased publishing FanNation sites, reducing Sports & Leisure digital advertising revenue.
changes.evidence: a $6,064 decrease in digital advertising revenue due to the cessation of publishing FanNation sites in early 2024

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired the ShopHQ brand, Lindy's Sports, and Autoblog, expanding into commerce and new verticals.
changes.evidence: Leveraging our 2025 acquisition of the ShopHQ brand and its extensive first-party customer data to bridge the gap between media and marketplace.
